A_empty_response.description: Empty text response generated by model or harness
A_empty_response.technical_cause: For v1.2, raw invocation without frontend prompt conversation wrappers causes fallback empty returns. For v1.3, fixed 64 max tokens on short answers terminates token sequence when EOS is reached early.

B_prompt_echo.description: Response merely echoes or repeats the prompt text
B_prompt_echo.technical_cause: None observed. RoPE position embeddings and instruction tuning prevent prompt echo loops.

C_repetition.description: Response contains repeating n-grams or word loops
C_repetition.technical_cause: Greedy deterministic decoding (temperature=0.0) on short context queries can enter local n-gram probability traps at end of sequence.

D_incorrect_answer.technical_cause: SymPy Math Engine handles exact math calculations deterministically (0 errors). Open-ended unverified reasoning yields INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE for human-level scoring.

E_instruction_violation.description: Failure to satisfy requested format or constraint
E_instruction_violation.technical_cause: Structural instruction following evaluated cleanly for format constraints.

F_tool_routing_issue.description: Failure to route request to correct tool handler
F_tool_routing_issue.technical_cause: Tool Router correctly dispatches General, Math, Code, and Document intents.

G_math_routing_issue.description: Math query not routed to SymPy Math Engine
G_math_routing_issue.technical_cause: 100% of mathematical prompts correctly routed to SymPy Math Engine.

H_rag_issue.description: RAG document retrieval or citation failure
H_rag_issue.technical_cause: RAG document retrieval, citations, missing info protection, and 403 access control passed 100%.

I_context_limitation.description: Crash or exception due to sequence context bounds
I_context_limitation.technical_cause: Evaluated context window up to 1024 max sequence length without crashes or NaN/Inf values.

J_latency_performance_issue.technical_cause: FP32 + KV cache delivers ~2.75x speedup (~46-59 tok/s), satisfying CPU throughput targets.

K_benchmark_harness_limitation.description: Failure caused by test harness invocation mode rather than model capability
K_benchmark_harness_limitation.technical_cause: v1.2 in production relies on its hybrid orchestrator/template conversation wrappers. Raw generator invocation without template wrappers returns fallback empty responses.

L_other.description: Unclassified runtime exceptions or unexpected behavior
